speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly what the vertigo feels like—does it seem like the room is spinning around you, or do you feel like you are tilting or falling? Also, did this episode start suddenly while you were resting or moving?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any accompanying hearing loss, tinnitus, or a feeling of fullness in your ears? Also, does changing the position of your head, such as rolling over in bed or looking up, trigger the spinning sensation?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Sudden-onset sensation of the room spinning. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Dizziness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did the spinning sensation return when you rolled over in bed or looked up, and do you have any hearing loss or ringing in your ears? I need to know if specific head movements trigger the vertigo to distinguish between inner ear and neurological causes.
